balls.text: ah, pulls out the reverse sweep, can't connect and Dhoni throws the ball back to Murali who can't collect it, they run through for an extra. It's been that kind of night for Murali.
short again, stays back and cuts away to the off side
short ball outside off, Agarkar stays back and biffs it over wide long on.

pyrrhic victory for Murali! Mathews has swept the carpet from under hit feet today, but this time he sweeps to his demise, top edge loops up and Hayden is again under a swirler. Good innings comes to an end.
can't get this one away, straight back down the track for no run
someone's stolen the wizard's magic wand today. Wide down the leg
short and wide outside ball, rubbish ball from Murali, Angelo says thank you very much and cuts it behind point
missed run-out chance by Badri at point. Agarkar hit it straight to him and ran, and Badri took time to aim and throw down the stumps. Would have been an easy call if he'd hit.
this time the batsman moves towards the legside, Bolly follows him and fires it in short of a length, swish and a miss
Agarkar gets a thick outside edge that goes as fine as thick outside edges can go, without landing in the keeper's gloves. Crucial boundary
full toss on off stump, gets it away to the off side behind square

Gone! Short of a length outside off, Shukla went for a 360 degree pull, and would have been happy if it went anywhere, but not high. That's where the top edge went, Hayden was under it and took it easy at cover. Shukla has done his job though.
good length ball, draws the batsman forward, driven well down to long off
and again, replay of the previous ball. Good finish to an awry over from Murali
doosra outside off, almighty sweep expecting it to spin in, but it did not. Play and a miss
another sweep, fine this time and Hayden puts in the tumble at short fine leg
another powerful sweep, straight to the deep square leg fielder. Kolkata are recovering well.
outside off, stays back and works it off the pads very fine
and again, he's trying hard to deny room and concedes another wide down the leg
better ball, outside off, he gets down the track and plays it to the leg side
Murali is having a really poor day, big spin from middle and leg, well down the leg and Dhoni can't save five wides
thick outside edge off the attempted sweep, down to the offside for one
this time over the off side! Generates tremendous bat-speed and sends it flying over wide long off, even better shot this one!
that's hit really hard! Vijay was a few metres in at long on, and if he were back on the fence he could have possibly caught it, but this slog landed behind the ropes
swept hard from outside off towards deep square leg
great fielding at midwicket from Badri to deny the single
expertly played, opens the face to run it down from a fraction outside off stump, towards third man

Gone! Saha played it off the face off the bat, he wanted to go very fine and it went too fine for his liking, into Dhoni's right leg. He regained quickly and broke the stumps with Saha desperately trying to get back in.
leg stump line again, and worked away behind square for one
can't get it away, straight back to the bowler
sliding down the leg, gets some bat on it to deny his side the wide. Tumbling stop by Hayden at short fine
worked away from leg stump towards square leg
length ball turning in from off stump, worked away for a single to the leg side.
sees him coming and shortens the length, played back down to Raina

Murali Vijay has taken a really good catch!  Tiwary got under this flighted delivery from Raina and sent it high into the Chennai night-sky, and when it came down, metres in front of the long on fence, Vijay was there, running back a long way and taking it well.
looks to go big over the leg side, but the length is not there. It runs away along the ground.
similar line, worked away to the leg side
on off stump, stays back and works it away to midwicket
down the track again, sees him coming and shortens the length, played away straight to cover.
on leg stump again, tapped away near the wicket for a quick single
short this time, rocks back and cuts it away
full on the pads, looks to play it to the off side for one but can't get it through
worked away behind square on the leg side for a single
down the track, Jakati sees him and shortens the length, Tiwary gladly taps to the offside to rotate the strike
smashed! Again the slog-sweep from Mathews, he swung so hard that one hand came off the bat and the ball landed a few rows behind cow corner.
more turn, pops up off something on the leg side, Dhoni tidies up
and he plays down to the off side to rotate the strike
delicate! Waits on the ball, uses the pace and dabs it expertly down to third man. Very neat late cut
dodgy running there, but thankfully all is well. Mathews started late after playing down to short fine leg, but the direect hit missed.
length ball outside off, worker away to point for one
and again, Mathews is playing to some plan here, he probably has an idea how much is enough on the track. Blocked away off front foot.
fuller and straighter, Mathews blocks it away this time
another almighty slog sweep played well, takes it from outside off and bisects the leg side field.
better line, turns away from off stump, played away watchfully to the off side
on leg stump again, gets forward and flicks it nicely towards square leg. Good running too for the couple
drifts down leg and concedes a wide
on a length, on off, defended off front foot
over the stumps, on a length outside off, he stays back and dabs it to point for a run.
take that my fellow Sri Lankan! Mathews goes down on a knee and shovels it from outside off beyond the midwicket boundary. Good shot!
straighter, worked away straight to midwicket
nice shot! 83.3 kph is fast enough outside off, for Mathews to open the face and run it down to the third man fence
draws him forward, from round the wicket. Front foot block down to the bowler
full toss on leg stump, and he pulls out a rather daring reverse sweep, almost all the way to the boundary, but Badri puts in a dive and saves a couple. Good fielding.
on the pads this time, worked off the backfoot behind square leg
length ball, going in from off and middle, worked down towards long on. KKR have reached 50 finally.
stays back, and dabs it behind point for a single
very good bouncer, at 130 kph proving that it is not the pace, but the direction that matters more with the bumper. Tiwary takes evasive action, it was headed for his head
slower ball outside off, cut away to deep cover
length ball, angling into the pads, tip and run to midwicket
nice flight, on leg and turned away for a single
straightens the length, on leg stump, turned away to the leg side
length ball on off, stays back and punches it through cover
again short, but marginally straighter, and he cuts straight to point
shortens the length sufficiently for Tiwary to rock back and cut it well through point. Badri makes a mess of it on the point boundary, diving over the ball
full on middle and off from over the sticks, front foot defence from Tiwary
more acceptable length this time, worked away to the leg side for a single
digs it in really short, almost like he wants to test the trueness of the pitch. It is very true, it sails high over batsman and keeper and away for four wides
slower ball, 109 kph outside off, worked with the wrists down to long on
tip and run, played off the face straight to point and they are through.
good ball, short of a length and some effort as it rises up and hits the bat hard, before running down to the off side
straighter this time, Mathews stays back and works it down behind square on the leg side
drifting down the leg off a length, clips something en route to Dhoni
end of an awesome spell! Ashwin finishes it off with another variation, it looked like a genuine leg spinner this time. No bat, through to Dhoni.
big spin, takes something en route to leg slip
that unusual doosra this time, the batsman manages to pick it and play away towards square on the off for a couple
goes well outside off this time, Mathews gets forward and sweeps down to square leg
tuns down the leg this time, and it runs away to the boundary. Angelo is thrilled - runs have been hard to come by
on off stump, turning in, tucked away to leg
short and into Mathews who gets into a tight position, trying to work it towards the leg side
ooh, driven on the up almost straight to the fielder at cover, gets to him on the bounce
pitched up outside off, drawing the batsman forward. Tapped to mid off for one
nicely bowled! Brings it back in this time and eludes the inside edge by a whisker. Might have been a slight deflection, tough to call.
again, he lets it go outside off. Slips in place, arms being shouldered. No it is not a Test match.
length ball angling across the right hander. He lets it go.
great lines, keeps it outside off and turns it in without much fuss.
and again, Mathews tries to come down but can't combat the spin
turn! Turns in sharply from off stump
played in front of point for a brace
was there glove in that? Taufel thinks not, but the replays suggest he's denied Ashwin a hat-trick! Gloved off the pad down to leg slip, and the appeal was turned down.

Ashwin's got another one, what a spell this is! Looped on leg stump, turning down the leg, and Hussey was drawn out, could not make contact and over-balanced. Dhoni took the bails off before one could have said "Wide"!
jaffa! Angled across, pitched on middle and off, and it took off from a length. Did everything except take the outside edge. Wicket maiden for Bolly!
slower ball at 114 kph, slips down the leg tucked away for a leg bye
full toss outside off and Hussey junior can't get it past the offside cordon
short of a length, angling across Hussey who taps it to the off side

Chennai are all over Kolkata here! Bollinger had set this up the previous ball with the bouncer, this time he slips in the pacy full delivery aimed at Dada's pads. It strikes him flush, but outside leg stump. Umpire Hazare thinks it is out, and Chepauk does not mind, but that was a poor call.
take that! Bolly resorts to Dada's old weakness, the short ball and it is directed perfectly as the KKR skipper fends uncertainly

Ashwin is on fire! McCullum's not read him well this over, and was desperate to get him away. When in doubt, McCullum sweeps or scoops, it was the sweep this time, the top edge looked like it will fall behind short fine leg, but Muralitharan had other plans! Nice tumbling catch, Chepauk roars!
that was close! Carrom ball that hurried on to McCullum's pads from middle and leg, he had no clue about it. Only Taufel thought it was not out.
outside off, looked to work it away to the off side

and Ashwin strikes right back! Gayle was coming down the track this time, Ashwin held it back, and Gayle could not get to the pitch as it turned away. Dhoni does the rest! Got him with a beautiful bit of flight
see you later! Gayle has rocket-launched that into orbit, beyond the blimp, beyond stratosphere, and over the long on fence
goes full this time, almost a yorker on Dada's leg stump, and the flick goes straight to the midwicket fielder
gets bat on it this time! Short of a length again, Ganguly stays back and flat-bats it into the pitch, it bounces over the non-striker's end stumps for four
again, Dada is roaming around the crease and Bollinger follows him. On a length, cannons into his pads outside leg after missing his attempted heave
faster and straighter, and a tad shorter. Ganguly stays back and looks to flay it towards the leg side and cannot connect
improvisation! Looks to tuck Dada up for room, he backs away outside leg and creates enough room to force it behind point for four
short of a length outside off, but just straight enough to elude Ganguly's business area outside the off stump. He looks to cut and misses
length ball on leg, turning towards off, Gayle keeps it away. Great start from Ashwin
Dada jumps out and Ashwin shortens the length, played away to cover
persists with the line against Gayle, who tackes it in different style - works it away to midwicket off the front fott
similar line, Ganguly looks to carve over the off side and miscues it over the infield, lands safely over cover
shorter, turns from off to middle. He's bowling from round the stumps. Dada gets back and looks to cut
full on Dada's legs, he gets forward and defends to off side, off bat and pad
Raina finishes it off in typical fashion, and the authority of that shot underlines Chennai's dominance tonight. Swung away on one foot over midwicket. See you later Kolkata!
Vijay gets to another fifty! Cuts it away for a single to the off side
and this time a double-bouncer from Abdullah! Is he doing this on purpose? Lands close to his feet, bumps up and lands again before the batsman has a go. Very unusual variations
goes for another pull, cannot make connection this time

that's as high as you will ever see a cricket ball being hit! Vijay got well under that ball and got a thick top edge to the bottom-handed pull, it went miles and miles up in the air, and the laws of oblique projection will be stretched to justify how it landed beyond the ropes!
full slower ball, 115.4 kph, Raina drives down the ground and the bowler half-stops
good yorker, just outside off stump line, Raina misses and Saha collects it nicely, standing up
slides on to his pads and Vijay works it away easily behind square on the leg side
rank fulltoss outside off, Raina cuts it away, straight to the sweeper
fuller this time, driven straight to cover. Sane and quiet end to the over after that bizarre short ball
cuts away straight to point

I've never seen something like this! Abdullah was probably trying a bouncer, it bounced a couple of feet in front of him and went up in slow motion, when it came down Vijay was ready with his back lift to send it crashing through midwicket. Maybe, just maybe it slipped out of the bowler's hand.
short and wide outside off, cut away nicely by Vijay but straight to the short third man
short of a length, played away to the off side
plays it away for a couple more. Vijay has quietly crept up to 38, and is looking ominous now
beautiful shot! Vijay sashays down and drives elegantly through the off side. This game is ending really fast
swing and a miss! Somehow missed the stumps after eluding the sweep
shortens the length, Vijay knew it was coming, he was waiting on his back foot and WHACK over midwicket for four
Vijay tees off! Comes down the track, does not get to the pitch of it, but in this kind of form, it does not seem to matter to him. Nicely lofted straight over the sight screen for six
lucky to escape with that one, it was well wide of off stump, but the umpire let it go

Raina can play all the shots in the book, but he has a lot of work to do on the pull. Again, top-edges it over the keeper's head for four. Maybe he should just stop playing the shot, the way Sehwag did for a long time
very good sloe bouncer, Vijay just about dealt with it, pulled down behind square leg
slower ball, Vijay picks it early and glances it very fine to pick a couple. Dinda puts in the sliding save on the boundary
slides down the leg this time to gift a run and a ball.
pulled away to the leg side nicely for a single
Super shot from Raina! Gets down the track and lofts it miles into the air, that went high enough to puncture the blimp, which thankfully wasn't around, and landed well behind long on
comes down the track and looks to free his arms through the off side, the inside out cover drive is half-stopped by short cover
full toss on middle stump, played down to long on
outside leg stump, turning into Raina who works it away behind square
pitched up on off stump, gets forward and works it away to midwicket. They are milking the runs here. No hurry at all.
short of a length on off stump, cut away off the back foot
finishes the over with a length ball on middle and off, Vijay can't get it away through the leg side
Harsh, harsh call from the leg umpire. It was a slow bouncer, and may have just sailed over Vijay's head as it passed him. Wide by the rules, but harsh all the same
short of a length on leg stump, gets back, rises on his toes and clips it neatly to the leg side
gets it straighter this time, down to long on to give Raina the strike
tries to work this away to the leg side, but can't get past midwicket
on off stump this time, short of a length, Vijay gets back and plays it respectfully to the off side
grace from Vijay! Agarkar marginally outside off, Vijay stays back and opens the face to run it deftly down to third man. That flew in the air, but very safe

Raina goes downtown! Pitched up on middle and off, he jumps out and muscles it high over midwicket, that landed atleast 20 rows back and would have cleared a smaller ground. So much bat-speed in that, his left foot came off the ground, ala Dhoni. Fifty to Raina!
draws him forward and elicits the drive down to long off
good length on off, Vijay gets forward and hits to mid on
pitches it up on off, Raina gets forward and clips it away towards midwicket
tight line, middle and leg and Raina can't work it away to the leg side
nice start, on off, turning away, Vijay coems forward and plays it to the leg side
slower ball, 116.3 kph and Raina can't get bat on it as he opens the face, second bounce before it reaches Saha
Vijay does the needful, opens the face and taps it for a single to give red-hot Raina the strike
more control this time, guides the pull towards square leg

good bouncer, but it seems to be Chennai's day! Raina's problems with the short ball on display, he had no control over the pull shot, it went straight up and landed well behind the keeper and through for four
angles across from middle to off, Raina stays back and opens the face, and sends an eager Vijay back to his crease
marginally short and Vijay latches on, but can't find the gap. Down to square leg, in the air but safe
Hat-trick of fours! This time, he goes down on a knee and muscles it between long on and midwicket. Chennai roars!
he's picking his spots! Raina targets the vacant cover fence, moves to the leg side and goes up and over, inside out for four!
poor ball and beautifully played! Gayle did all the hard work, giving Raina the pace and the line to play with, Raina said thank you and kissed it on its way to the fine leg fence
short ball, Raina tries to pull but does not time it for a change and it runs away for a couple
hit hard down to square leg, but he has cover there
length ball., he comes down the track and it bobbles off bat and pad to the leg side
Kolkata have not had much luck in this innings, Raina gets a thick edge that runs very fine for four through third man
slower ball at 103 kph, and short enough for Raina to spot, wait and pull expertly down to the midwicket fence. He's looking really good tonight.
full again, Vijay looks to swipe it through the leg side and gets a thickish inside edge down to square leg
eludes Ganguly running back from mid on but only just! Short of a length, Vijay goes for the pull and does not time it well, but well enough to land safely
full slower ball on middle and leg, Vijay picked it and waited, but could not time the drive to mid on
nice looking drive off the back foot, to a length ball, ram rod straight. Did everything except elude mid on, who ran in and tidied up
no such problems over the leg side, mid on is in and Raina clears him easily. Four more
almost holed out to the lone ranger on the off side fence! Raina looks to open up and go inside out and it nearly carries to Tiwary running in from long off and diving forward.
ah, you can have as many slips as you want, but if you bowl it down the leg side it will not help Mr. Gayle. That was wrongly called wide too, it hit Raina
on middle and leg, gives himself room but can't score through the off side
down the track and dabbed away past the bowler for a single
shortens the length, Vijay tries to work it away to the leg side
full outside off, gets forward and defends
Raina has played three exquisite shots this over! This time through the off side, it is all timing. Dinda gave him a fraction of width outside off, Raina was waiting and punched it through covers
good length again, but this time the line is off-skew. Raina cashes in, rises on his toes and glances it nicely down to square leg
nice lengths from Dinda, he's not giving Raina anything to drive, stays back and works it away to the leg side
short of a length, on off stump, stays back and defends to the off side
very short, this pitch has spin and bounce! Wide called
Beautifully played! This is why Raina is held in high regard, he had almost no room to work with, stayed back and opened the face to let it hit the sweet spot and it ran away behind square
short and quick outside off, Vijay plays it away off the back foot towards third man
probing line, turns from leg to off, Raina plays it away watchfully. Get ready for a slow turning scrap here!
good lines! Outside Raina's off stump, he goes for an expansive drive and misses
nicely played, opened the face and worked it off the front foot behind square

one left-handed basher gets rid of another! Length ball on middle and leg from round the stumps, Hayden goes for a big sweep and can't make contact. Stumps are down, Kolkata are kicked, but Gayle maintains his zen look. Classic!
outside Hayden's off stump, he lets it go
straighter and shorter, tucked away off the backfoot for one
Spin! Slides down the leg side unfortunately for KKR and runs away for five wides. It was a legside stumping chance as well, albeit a tough one.
